title: Employee & Channel Intelligence
subtitle: Who sold it, who rang it up, and through which channel.

attribution.subtitle: Which column on the order carries the seller, chosen by measuring the data rather than assuming.
attribution.unavailable: No column on the order carries a usable seller, so sales cannot be attributed to a person in this period.
attribution.note: The field is chosen by measured coverage, not by a fixed order. A column that exists but is empty attributes nothing, and a column whose id points at an empty table attributes nothing either.
attribution.unattributedNote: Orders with no seller are their own row. They are never shared out across the named sellers, because that would credit performance nobody earned.

breakdown.subtitle: Revenue is net of returns, on the same basis as the Executive Overview.
breakdown.empty: Nothing to break down in this period.
breakdown.withheld: The per-seller breakdown is withheld: too few orders in this period carry a seller for it to mean anything.
breakdown.cashierNote: The cashier is who rang the sale up. That is a different question from who sold it.

sellers.subtitle: Revenue only. Cost of goods sits on the order line, and a line has no seller, so there is no per-seller margin.
sellers.empty: No seller sold anything in this period.

concentration.title: Seller concentration
concentration.subtitle: How much of the attributed revenue rests on how few people.
concentration.unavailable: Fewer than two sellers in this period, so there is nothing to concentrate.

trend.subtitle: Net sales and the number of sellers active in each period.

highlights.title: What to look at
highlights.empty: Nothing needs attention in this period.
highlights.attributionUnavailable: Sales cannot be attributed to a person in this period, because no order carries a seller.
highlights.attributionPartial: {{coveragePercent}} of orders carry a seller. {{unattributedValue}} of net sales is not attributed to anybody.
highlights.sellerConcentration: {{sharePercent}} of attributed sales came from one seller, out of {{sellers}}.
highlights.teamUp: Net sales rose {{changePercent}} against the comparison period.
highlights.teamDown: Net sales fell {{changePercent}} against the comparison period.

basis.title: How these figures are built
basis.revenue: Net sales is canonical order revenue less returns — the same arithmetic as the Executive Overview, so the totals agree.
basis.noProfit: There is no per-seller profit. Cost of goods is attributable to an order line, and a line carries no seller; splitting an order's cost to reach a seller margin would be an allocation the data does not support.
basis.notCommission: This is not commission. Commission and payroll are calculated in the Employees module, with their own rules.

states.empty: There were no sales in this period.
states.emptyHint: Try a longer period, or clear the filters.
states.error: The employee report could not be loaded.
states.forbidden: You do not have access to reports.
